editionLabel: Pearl Games / Z-Man Games English rules, 2012
firstPlayerRule: The player who last read a history book starts.
clarifications: Give that player the Start Player card. The initial citizen placement goes clockwise in the first pass, counterclockwise in the second, and alternates thereafter. The card passes left after each round.
